extracted.intended_audience: comedians, performers, and festival attendees (Houston-area comedy community)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and descriptive criteria for programming, venue selection, and audience experience for a multi-venue comedy festival (The Riot Comedy Festival). Useful for producers, bookers, and performers considering participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival vision — connect fans with comedians through a fun and intimate experience
rubrics_metrics.description: "The vision for the festival is to connect fans with comedians through a fun and intimate experience and to bring the comedy industry to Houston."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programming and venue choices should prioritize intimacy and direct fan–performer connection (smaller rooms, close seating, meet-and-greets) and support bringing industry activity to the local scene.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programming variety — broad mix of show types
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Riot Comedy Festival puts on over thirty events including famous comedians, standup, podcasts, improv, music, a national comedy contest, and more."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A successful festival includes multiple formats (standup, podcasts, improv, music), competitions, and both headline and emerging acts to appeal to diverse audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue selection — mix of intimate rooms and larger historic theatre with good sightlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Arena Theatre: "over 2,700 seats in the round! With seats no further than 20 rows back there is not a bad seat in the house." The Riot Comedy Club: "This 150-seat comedy room..." The Gordy: hosts a 160-seat black box and a 300-seat Comedy Theater.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose venues that preserve audience proximity and sightlines for intimacy (small clubs ~150 seats, black box rooms), while using larger historic theatres for marquee kickoffs; ensure venue capacities match show scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience experience — events and social activities to engage attendees
rubrics_metrics.description: "Catch the Festival Day Party, Bar Crawls, and other fun events Including our 2nd annual BBQ Cookoff featuring all-you-can-eat BBQ from Houston's Best Pitmasters."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supplement shows with parties, day events, bar crawls, and festival-specific attractions (e.g., BBQ cookoff) to create a festival atmosphere and multiple engagement points beyond performances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community & volunteer involvement — producer/volunteer-driven model
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Riot Comedy Festival is an annual community event created by the founder... Alongside his team of associate producers and dozens of volunteers The Riot Comedy Festival puts on over thirty events..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rely on local producers, associate producers, and volunteers to run a multi-show festival; emphasize community engagement and local partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headliner curation — booking recognizable and varied headliners
rubrics_metrics.description: "This years headliners include Matthew Broussard, Timmy No Brakes, Tommy Pope, Isabel Hagen, Andy Huggins, Lemaire Lee, Shawn Gardini, Nate Marshall, and more!"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include named headliners to market the event and attract audiences; balance known touring comedians with local or emerging talent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival scale & timing — concentrated multi-day schedule with many shows and performers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run the festival across a compact multi-day window with numerous concurrent events and a sizeable roster of performers to create momentum and variety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival headquarters & on-site amenities — central hub for vendors and food
rubrics_metrics.description: "Festival headquarters is at The Gordy with food and vendors in the lobby, on the front lawn for our BBQ Cookoff event."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designate a festival HQ with space for vendors, food, and event coordination to centralize attendee services and festival programming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticketing & promotion timing — early-bird sales and downloadable materials
rubrics_metrics.description: "Early Bird Tickets available June 1st!... Download PDF"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use tiered ticketing (early bird) and provide downloadable informational materials to facilitate promotion and advance planning for attendees.
